title: Friendly or Not
description: Friendly or Not changes the way peaceful creatures react when they are attacked.
body:
Friendly or Not

🐮 Friendly or Not changes the way peaceful creatures react when they are attacked. When you hit a cow, sheep, or any other neutral mob, not only does the struck animal react — all nearby members of the same species also become aggressive and chase you as a group.

🦊 This mod adds a more natural and exciting group behavior to the Minecraft world. Neutral mobs stop acting like isolated entities and begin responding together to violence, making animal encounters feel more real and intense.

Increases tension when attacking peaceful mobs.
Triggers nearby mobs of the same type to become aggressive.
Enhances immersion without adding complex mechanics.

🐷 Perfect for players who want a more dynamic Minecraft experience and want their actions to have more visible consequences for local wildlife.

⚙️ Customizable:

You can edit the radius at which animals of the same species alert each other, as well as the length of time they will remain aggressive before calming down.
